limits: Low-stock arithmetic checks existing QA rows against displayed thresholds; this is not a new-alert delivery/timing test.
Recent Activity checks existing sales and stock entries, not a seeded fresh event or every stream ordering boundary.

Configured widgets are saved only in isolated test-browser layout state, not the user's desktop browser. No company setting or transaction is written. Failed source binding blocks meaningful widget financial/date certification.
AOV/revenue source values are a binding oracle; underlying transaction eligibility/rounding/date boundaries require further reconciliation after live widgets are fixed.
automation: Wait for the observed reporting/dashboard/stats GET before checking metrics; initial zero/$ placeholders are not final results.

Widget edit mode shows configuration placeholders. Tests now save the isolated local layout before verifying actual values/content. The initial edit-mode absence was not reported as an application defect.

Reset selects a six-widget sample template, not the original empty layout. Integrated checks remove only their own local widgets via observed UI controls to restore the initial/default view between steps; no business data is reset.

bugs.title: Gross profit and net margin are unavailable as Dashboard KPI metrics
steps: Sign in to the approved QA company and open Dashboard.
Wait for the dashboard to finish loading its business data.
Choose Customize Dashboard, Add Widget, then Stat Card.
Inspect the complete Select Metric list for Gross Profit and Net Margin.
Cancel without changing the user's saved layout.
bugs.expected: Phase 2 dashboard analytics offers gross profit and net margin metrics as required, with company data rather than invented values.
bugs.actual: The available Stat Card metrics include stock, products, suppliers, customers, orders, Revenue, stores, transfers, AOV and conversion rate, but no gross profit or net margin. The default dashboard has neither metric.
bugs.comment: User confirmed Phase 2 requirements are expected on production. This is a missing required KPI capability, not a guessed formula failure. Add the metrics and independently validate their defined cost/revenue calculations after implementation.

bugs.title: Dashboard sales trends lack daily/weekly/monthly period selection
steps: Open the hydrated Dashboard in Nexstock QA Company.
Inspect the dashboard for sales date/period grouping controls.
Choose Customize Dashboard, Add Widget, then Line Chart.
Inspect data sources and any date range/grouping controls; attempt to choose a weekly revenue view.
Compare the available Revenue Trend/Monthly Performance options with the required daily, weekly and monthly views.
bugs.expected: Users can inspect daily, weekly and monthly sales trends, including a usable weekly view and explicit period/grouping controls or equivalent views.
bugs.actual: The default dashboard has no sales period switcher. Line Chart offers Revenue Trend, Monthly Performance and other data sources, but no weekly source or daily/weekly/monthly grouping selector. No weekly view is reachable through those inspected controls.
bugs.comment: This is the Phase 2 period-view requirement, not Phase 3 period-over-period comparisons. Implement the supported period views and verify aggregation/date boundaries with seeded sales.

bugs.title: Saved configured Dashboard widgets render sample values or the wrong selected data source
steps: Open Dashboard in Nexstock QA Company and let the live reporting data load.
Choose Customize Dashboard, Add Widget, then Stat Card. Give it a QA title and select Revenue; add it and Save Layout in the isolated QA browser.
Compare the rendered Revenue with the reporting/dashboard/stats response generated by that same screen.
Repeat with Total Orders and Avg. Order Value.
Add and save a Line Chart using Revenue Trend and inspect its displayed month labels against the live revenue series.
Add and save a Data Table using Top Products; inspect the rendered columns and products.
Remove only the test widgets in the isolated browser to return to the original default layout.
bugs.expected: Each saved widget uses its selected data source and the current QA company's live values. Top Products shows sales quantity/revenue ranking, not an unrelated low-stock table.
bugs.actual: The observed live response has revenue 5,890, 34 orders and AOV 173.24, while configured Stat Cards show Rs 458,920.00, 1,156 orders and Rs 397.00. Top Products renders a low-stock table with Current/Min/Store/Status columns and sample items such as Laptop Charger/HDMI Cable. The configured line chart also renders sample month labels instead of the live May-October revenue series.
bugs.comment: Grouped source-binding defect across configured widgets, not separate tickets for each repeated sample value. These observations do not prove data from another real tenant was exposed. Bind widgets to their selected live data source; remove demo fallbacks from production views and rerun arithmetic/ranking/chart checks.

bugs.title: Dashboard has no branch scope switcher for isolated location metrics
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company, which has multiple existing QA branches.
Open Dashboard and wait for the live data.
Inspect the dashboard controls for All Branches versus an individual location.
Inspect Branch Comparison and attempt to isolate one branch's metrics rather than displaying all branches together.
bugs.expected: Users can select company-wide metrics or a specific branch and see the corresponding scoped analytics.
bugs.actual: The dashboard contains an aggregate Branch Comparison chart but no branch/store/location scope selector. The company business selector is not a branch filter.
bugs.comment: This is a missing Phase 2 analytics-scoping capability, not a claim of RBAC bypass. Add the branch scope control and verify that KPIs, trends, rankings, alerts and activity use the same chosen branch.
